summary: Implemented an offline fixture-only live-shaped market snapshot adapter. It converts Polymarket-like read-only fixture snapshots into existing crypto numeric raw market intake records, rejects malformed snapshots with deterministic reason codes, and verifies adapted output can feed the existing intake/scoring/review/paper-plan chain.
limitations: Fixture-only adapter; no live fetcher, network call, external API call, or read-only integration is implemented.
Current price, volatility, and momentum are fixture fields, not live market data.
Adapter output targets the existing raw intake format and does not replace the intake/scoring/paper lifecycle chain.
No runtime integration, dispatcher/run_codex, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-016: add an offline read-only fetcher contract test harness that validates future fetched snapshots against the live-shaped fixture contract without network calls.
